title: Learn about Gemini Notebook’s plans - Gemini Notebook Help

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook's usage limit for notebooks per user is 100 without an AI plan, according to Google's help page.
Gemini Notebook's limit for all sources except notes is 50 per notebook without an AI plan, according to Google's help page.
Gemini Notebook's limit for notes sources is 500 per notebook on the free, Plus and Pro plans, and 600 per notebook on the Ultra 20 TB and Ultra 30 TB plans, according to Google's help page.
According to Google's help page, Gemini Notebook watermark removal is not available without an AI plan or on Plus, and is available on Pro and Ultra plans.
A visible watermark is applied automatically to Gemini Notebook outputs for users residing in India, South Korea, or Vietnam, regardless of plan.
facts.quote: A visible watermark will be applied automatically if you reside in India, South Korea, or Vietnam.

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook's Earlier Access to Key Features is Standard without an AI plan, Early on Plus, and Priority on Pro and both Ultra plans, according to Google's help page.
facts.quote: Earlier Access to Key Features**Standard Early Priority Priority Priority

facts.fact: For daily quotas, Gemini Notebook limits reset after 24 hours, and monthly quotas reset after 30 days, according to Google's help page.
facts.quote: If your plan is on daily quotas, these reset after 24 hours. Monthly quotas reset after 30 days.

facts.fact: Google states that generated artifacts such as reports, flashcards, or audio overviews created automatically when sources are added do not count toward limits.
facts.quote: These are generated once and do not contribute to limits.

facts.fact: Google states that Gemini Notebook for enterprise through Google Cloud offers 5X or more notebook artifacts than the consumer plans, according to Google's help page.
facts.quote: 5X or more notebook artifacts, including Audio Overviews, Video Overviews, Reports, and more.

facts.fact: Google states that Gemini Notebook usage limits are subject to change.
